verdict.rationale: Proa documents incremental adoption at the route level: proxy one route to Proa while the rest stays on Next.js or Rails. It can also be called over FFI from Node, Go, Python, Ruby or Java, or adapted to another HTTP server, and scaffolds full applications via `proa new site` and the kitchen-sink starter. Islands add client JS only where signals are used, but that applies within Proa-rendered pages rather than embedding Proa into part of an existing page. Missing for 10: documented embedding of a Proa component into a fragment of an existing non-Proa page, a step-by-step incremental migration guide, independent or hands-on corroboration.
